delete.blurb: Permanently deletes your account, your private charts and their images. Charts you shared with a practice stay with the practice.

account.confirmMessage: This permanently deletes your account, your private charts, and their photos and radiographs. Charts you shared with a practice stay with that practice. If you’re the only person in your practice, the practice and all its charts are deleted too, and any subscription is cancelled. This can’t be undone.
account.promptMessage: Type your email ({{email}}) to permanently delete your account.

practice.confirmMessage: This permanently deletes the practice and every chart shared with it — including charts your team members created — along with their photos and radiographs. Any subscription is cancelled immediately. Team members keep their accounts and their private charts. This can’t be undone.
practice.promptMessage: Type the practice name ({{name}}) to permanently delete it.
practice.promptMessageUnnamed: Type DELETE to permanently delete this practice.
